blocks.text: Hum roz dekhte hain ke jab bahar ka temperature aur pressure badalta hai to gas ki given amount (di hui miqdar) ka volume bhi badal jata hai.

blocks.title: Gas laws
blocks.text: Gas laws batate hain ke gas ki given amount ka volume, maujooda temperature aur pressure se kaise related (juda hua) hai.
Boyle’s law aur Charles’ law mein kuch variables (badalne wali cheezen) constant rakhe jate hain. Boyle’s law ke mutabiq:

blocks.latex: V \propto \frac{1}{P} \qquad \text{(when } n \text{ and } T \text{ are held constant)} \quad \ldots\ldots\ (1)
V \propto T \qquad \text{(when } n \text{ and } P \text{ are held constant)} \quad \ldots\ldots\ (2)
blocks.text_alt: V ∝ T   (when ‘n’ and ‘P’ are held constant) …… (2)

blocks.text: Avogadro’s law ke mutabiq constant temperature aur pressure par gas ka volume moles ki tadaad ke directly proportional (jitna ek barhe utna doosra) hota hai:

blocks.latex: V \propto n \qquad \text{(when } P \text{ and } T \text{ are held constant)} \quad \ldots\ldots\ (3)
blocks.text_alt: V ∝ n   (when P and T are held constant) …… (3)

blocks.text: Ab farz karein ke koi bhi variable constant nahi rakha jata. Tab teenon relations ko jor kar likh sakte hain:
Is constant ko ‘R’ kehte hain, yani ideal gas constant. Is ki value 0.0821 atm dm³ K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ hai.
Equation (4) ko ideal gas equation kehte hain.
